scope.summary: Implement a restricted pure-Rust USD profile for only qualified layers, references, variants, UsdSkel, materials, curves, caches, cameras and lights, with explicit unsupported schemas and exact target qualification profiles.
acceptance_criteria: USD packages preserve units/axis/time/topology/skeleton/blendshapes/caches/material bindings/dependencies and pass usdchecker plus reimport.

Blender and Unreal are required initial release profiles; every Blender, Unreal, Maya, Houdini, 3ds Max, and Cinema 4D capability row records requirement_status as required, accepted_exclusion, optional, or deliberate_exceedance independently from qualification_status as unimplemented, implemented_unqualified, qualified, stale, failed, or unsupported, so absence is explicit and parity is never implied.
Required profiles fail closed when the named tool/importer version or visual/metric evidence is unavailable; developer smoke lanes may record skips separately.

The initial production qualification families are Blender 4.5 LTS and Unreal Engine 5.8 based on current official vendor releases; signed refinement pins the exact patch/build id, importer/plugin versions, platform, executable/package sha256, and acquisition source in toolchain-lock.json before execution.

The active TailorInterchangeProfile or runtime capability row records exact direction, versions, hashes, supported payloads, losses, unsupported cases, privacy behavior, artifacts and qualification receipts before the action is exposed.

Proof includes successful canonical Rust behavior plus one missing/removed-adapter or unsupported-direction case and demonstrates no partial authority mutation, silent fallback, data loss or false qualification.

The product path is Rust-owned, local and offline: Python/PyTorch, generated executable scripts, cloud services, implicit network access and runtime downloads are prohibited; optional adapters are pinned and removable.
scope.risk_if_missed: A broad professional-production claim is false without versioned composition and target qualification.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
